note: Applicability is not stored on controls. A control applies to a system when at least one requirement it satisfies applies to that system, so the crosswalk is the single source of truth.

controls.name: AI system inventory and registration
controls.objective: Every AI system in use is registered with an accountable owner, purpose, model provenance and lifecycle stage before it goes live.

controls.name: AI policy and governance mandate
controls.objective: An approved AI policy, a standing governance forum and documented decision rights for AI risk acceptance.

evidence.name: Governance forum terms of reference and minutes

controls.name: Prohibited-practice screening
controls.objective: Each system is screened against the Article 5 prohibitions before build and again after any material change of purpose.

controls.name: Risk classification and derogation assessment
controls.objective: The regulatory tier of each system is determined, evidenced and re-checked on change; any Annex III derogation is documented.

controls.name: AI risk management system
controls.objective: A continuous, documented risk management cycle per system: identify, evaluate, mitigate, test the mitigation, repeat.

controls.name: AI impact assessment (fundamental rights)
controls.objective: Impacts on individuals, groups and society are assessed before first use, with mitigations and a named accountable owner.

controls.name: Data protection impact assessment
controls.objective: A DPIA is completed and signed off where the processing meets a high-risk trigger, with design measures recorded.

controls.name: Lawful basis and purpose register
controls.objective: Every processing purpose has a recorded lawful basis, and the record of processing reflects the live system.

controls.name: Special category and biometric authorisation
controls.objective: Special category or biometric processing is authorised under a specific condition, with an additional necessity test.

controls.name: Training data governance and provenance
controls.objective: Datasets used for training, validation and testing are documented: source, licence, preparation, representativeness and known gaps.

controls.name: Bias examination and fairness evaluation
controls.objective: Bias is examined before release and re-measured on a schedule, with subgroup results and a documented mitigation decision.

evidence.name: Bias evaluation report with subgroup metrics

controls.name: Technical documentation pack
controls.objective: Annex IV style technical documentation exists, is version-controlled and is kept current with the deployed system.

controls.name: Model card and instructions for use
controls.objective: Deployers and operators receive capabilities, limitations, accuracy metrics, foreseeable misuse and oversight measures in writing.

controls.name: Event logging and traceability
controls.objective: Inputs, outputs, model version and human decisions are logged so any individual outcome can be reconstructed.

controls.name: Human oversight design and override
controls.objective: A competent human can interpret the output, decide not to act on it, override it and stop the system, and that path is tested.

controls.name: Oversight competence and AI literacy
controls.objective: The people operating and overseeing the system are trained on its limits, its failure modes and their intervention duties.

controls.name: Accuracy and robustness testing
controls.objective: Performance is measured against declared metrics in deployment-like conditions before release and on a schedule after.

evidence.name: Test, evaluation, verification and validation plan

controls.name: Adversarial testing and AI security
controls.objective: The system is tested against adversarial input, prompt injection, data poisoning and model extraction, and findings are tracked to closure.

controls.name: Transparency notice and AI disclosure
controls.objective: People are told they are dealing with an AI system, what it does with their data and how to reach a human.

evidence.name: Privacy notice covering the AI processing

controls.name: Synthetic content marking
controls.objective: AI-generated or manipulated output carries machine-readable marking and a human-visible label where required.

controls.name: Explanation and contestation route
controls.objective: An affected person can get a meaningful explanation of the AI system's role in a decision and contest it to a human.

controls.name: Quality management system
controls.objective: A documented QMS ties regulatory strategy, design controls, data management, testing and post-market activity together with accountability.

controls.name: Conformity assessment and declaration
controls.objective: The applicable conformity assessment route is completed before market placement and repeated after substantial modification.

controls.name: Post-market monitoring
controls.objective: A monitoring plan actively collects performance, complaint and misuse data in production and feeds it back into the risk register.

evidence.name: Monitoring output reviewed by the owner
Feedback loop into the risk register

controls.name: AI incident response and reporting
controls.objective: AI incidents are detected, triaged against the reporting thresholds, escalated on the clock and closed with a root cause.

evidence.name: AI incident response procedure with reporting deadlines

controls.name: Third-party model and supplier due diligence
controls.objective: Model and data suppliers are assessed and contractually bound to the obligations the organisation has to pass down.

controls.name: Deployer operating controls
controls.objective: The system is used within its instructions, input data is relevant and representative, and affected workers are informed before deployment.

evidence.name: Operating procedure aligned to instructions for use

controls.name: International transfer safeguards
controls.objective: Personal data leaving the EEA, including to model inference endpoints, is covered by a transfer mechanism and a risk assessment.

evidence.name: Inference and hosting data flow map

controls.name: GPAI documentation and copyright policy
controls.objective: Where the organisation provides a general-purpose model, model documentation, a training-content summary and a copyright policy are maintained.
